title: Page 89
transc:
S. P. Kimber  Wash'n June 7th 1864
Happy June Downing Imogene For Mastiff Tulip
What is the guage Talbot Hero and
Monroe Walnut Stanhope In the annual Watson
of Norris Brown January Ludlow Perkins Allen
Directors Watson no grading between Monroe and
Shreveport Yacht It is not likely that
any work has been done upon it
since this rebellion yardstick It is Prentiss
Andrew and Allen quarter Sylvans from Holly
to Monroe Wiley Meigs Buggy damp again


S. P. Kimber  Washington DC June 10th 1864
Hunter June French Gertrude For Mastiff tulip The Belgrade
yoke day Webbs are ordered to Traction and those
from Alias to Daniel for such disposition as you 
deem best yacht Your attention is respectfully called to
the necessity of dis mounting poor Pekin Waynes so
as to completely ream mount the better Allens yardstick
It will not be possible to supply them all
with ream mounts tulip Your attention is also called
to re Whistling Waylands the companies of which have
been separated Welch Lady Please time all your dispatches
